subject: literacy
concept: Writing a full rhetorical analysis essay evaluating a text's purpose, appeals, devices, and overall effectiveness, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a purpose/appeals/devices/effectiveness organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a rhetorical analysis essay evaluating a text's purpose, rhetorical appeals, devices, and overall effectiveness

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay addresses purpose, at least one rhetorical appeal, at least one device, and an overall effectiveness judgment, all supported with textual evidence
misconception_flags: identifies rhetorical elements individually without connecting them into an overall argument about the text's effectiveness

interest_binding: text generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
